Name: development-2
Purpose: The figures of the sprints before the gates, for comparison between sprints only, from Epic 1, sprint S06 on: the same machine and versions as the manifest development, with a run that may have one writer beside the measured reads. No figure under this manifest judges a gate, and the manifest needs no approval (docs/work/epic-1-core.md, Acceptance, rules for every measurement).

Machine.Processor: Intel Core i9-13900H, 14 cores, 20 logical processors
Machine.Memory: 64 GiB DDR5, two modules of 32 GiB at 5,200 MT/s

Virtualization: None: the program runs on the operating system, in no container and no virtual machine
Run: One process, started by hand from src with dotnet run in the Release configuration, on a machine without other heavy work; the measured reads of a scenario run on one thread, and a series may run one writer on a thread of its own beside them
